name: settings-refactor
title: Settings UI Refactor & Agent Management
description: Comprehensive refactor of settings dialog: remove empty-shell agents, design AgentConfigAdapter trait, unify MCP data sources, extend skill/API provider management with per-agent adaptation, and restructure the settings module.
creator: re2zero
notes: Settings dialog is 3281 lines in a single file. Provider registry has 4 empty-shell agents. MCP has dual data sources. No per-agent config format adaptation beyond Claude/OpenCode/Generic.

key_changes: Remove empty-shell agents (copilot, kimi, cursor, windsurf)
Design AgentConfigAdapter trait for per-agent config formats
Implement adapters for: claude, codex, opencode, droid, pi, omp, kilo, hermes
Unify MCP data sources (Zenix NDJSON + per-agent into single view)
Extend skill management with per-agent format support
Extend API provider config generation for all supported agents
Restructure settings module (split large file, add state management)
Add search/filter state, form state, and UI state as separate concerns
